description: This file is the MainActivity class of an Android application demonstrating app restrictions. It manages the user interface, interacts with shared preferences, and reads application restrictions from UserManager to display current restrictions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing app restriction UI and displaying current restrictions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, and loads preference for custom restrictions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the UI with current restrictions retrieved from UserManager and displays their values.

methods.name: onCustomClicked
methods.description: Handles the checkbox click to save custom restriction preference.
